Everything you need for exceptional support
Powerful features designed to streamline your customer support workflow, from AI automation to team collaboration and advanced analytics.
Canned Responses
Create and manage pre-written responses with dynamic variables
Hi {customer_name}, I'll help you reset your password. Please click the link we've sent to {email} and follow the instructions.
Human in Loop
Seamless handoff between AI and human agents
White Label Email
Send responses from your own branded email addresses
Multiple Inboxes
Separate inboxes for different teams and departments
Tagging & Priority
Organize tickets with smart tagging and priority management
Search & Filter
